changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'graph' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Filter') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [graph].[Filter] ( [Uid] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, [Name] nvarchar(250) NOT NULL, [Settings] varchar(max) NOT NULL, [IsPublic] bit NOT NULL, [IsDefault] bit NOT NULL, [OwnedBy] int NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_GraphFilter] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [Uid] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.default_constraints where name = 'DF_GraphFilter_Uid') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [graph].[Filter] ADD CONSTRAINT [DF_GraphFilter_Uid] DEFAULT (newid()) FOR [Uid] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.default_constraints where name = 'DF_GraphFilter_IsPublic') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [graph].[Filter] ADD CONSTRAINT [DF_GraphFilter_IsPublic] DEFAULT (0) FOR [IsPublic] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.default_constraints where name = 'DF_GraphFilter_IsDefault') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [graph].[Filter] ADD CONSTRAINT [DF_GraphFilter_IsDefault] DEFAULT (0) FOR [IsDefault] END
